text: Two ways to fix this. (a) Split every stored booking that crosses midnight into two records, one per day: a data migration, and each split booking gets a second reference that carriers and the dock would see. (b) Keep one record per booking and select by overlap with the day at query time: no migration, and it can be taken out again. Which?

verbatim: b. One truck is one booking, keep it as one record. Work out the overlap when you query, no migration.
